alex: noted. I'll add alerting thresholds to the canary policy.

maya: To pin and promote use:
```
rcctl pin rc42 --commit=3b7a1f9 --env=prod --note='rc42 billing migration'
rcctl promote rc42 --strategy=canary --canary=1%:30m
```

deploy-bot: ack. Scheduled pin for 2026-03-20T21:30:00Z; promotion window 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z-22:30:00Z. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/releases/rc42
